facts.fact: Revises F251: when Devan's ribs reopen under the strike, Neela in shape recognises at once that it is the wound-share Ammu described ('A cut on him opens on you'), and weighs it in the stay-or-follow choice: if she is speared, he bleeds too.
Chathu shouts 'The jackal has Pachan's key' (not 'my keys'), matching Ammu lifting Pachan's key ring.
